Plot estimate sensitivity to the kernel order

Source: R/plot-tuning.R
plot_tuning.Rd

Evaluates or reuses the candidate kernel orders of a tuning grid (default: the paper rule's lambda grid via tuning_dnn_paper(), always including the fitted s) and plots the estimates with confidence bounds against s, marking the fitted kernel order with a filled point and a dotted guide. For grid fits, the stored tuning_grid payload is consumed directly. For scalar fits, the internal grid engine is used on the stored model state; public estimators are not refit.

Usage

plot_tuning(
  object,
  tuning = tuning_dnn_paper(),
  targets = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  se = TRUE,
  candidates = "all",
  ...
)

# Default S3 method
plot_tuning(
  object,
  tuning = tuning_dnn_paper(),
  targets = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  se = TRUE,
  candidates = "all",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'np_result'
plot_tuning(
  object,
  tuning = tuning_dnn_paper(),
  targets = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  se = TRUE,
  candidates = "all",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'cate_result'
plot_tuning(
  object,
  tuning = tuning_dnn_paper(),
  targets = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  se = TRUE,
  candidates = "all",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'affine_ratio_result'
plot_tuning(
  object,
  tuning = tuning_dnn_paper(),
  targets = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  se = TRUE,
  candidates = "all",
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'plqr_result'
plot_tuning(
  object,
  tuning = tuning_dnn_paper(),
  targets = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  se = TRUE,
  candidates = "all",
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted np_result, cate_result, affine_ratio_result (including clate_result), or plqr_result.

tuning

A tuning specification for the candidate grid. Scalar fits use their retained tuning specification when omitted. Fits with a manually chosen s use tuning_dnn_paper(), including that fitted order; optional return fields do not change the sweep. An explicit specification overrides that scalar grid. Stored grid fits reuse their existing candidates.

targets

Optional integer vector of target ids (defaults to at most three: first, middle, last).

level

Confidence level for the bounds (default 0.95).

se

Logical; compute jackknife bounds for each candidate when object is a scalar fit (default TRUE). Stored grid fits reuse the standard errors already present in object$tuning_grid.

candidates

Candidate rows to display. The default "all" shows the tuning sweep; a character vector of candidate ids or "default" can be used to restrict the display.

...

Ignored; reserved for future options.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Scalar grid evaluation uses the training data stored on the fit; fits from package versions predating that storage must be re-estimated first.

Experimental methods

Methods for plqr_result objects are experimental, as is all PLQR functionality in this release; see plqr_dnn().

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  set.seed(1)
  n <- 100
  x_mat <- matrix(rnorm(n * 2), n, 2)
  y_vec <- x_mat[, 1] + rnorm(n, sd = 0.3)
  fit <- np_dnn(X = x_mat, x0 = c(0, 0), Y = y_vec, k = 1L)
  plot_tuning(fit)
}

# }
